# Replay-Nonce presence, uniqueness, and Cache-Control on newNonce are
# checked by the harness on every response.

HEAD $dir.newNonce
$code == 200

GET $dir.newNonce
$code == 204

POST $dir.newAccount
payload {}
$code == 201

POST-as-GET $account.url
sign nonce reuse
error == badNonce

# The nonce from the error response is usable.
POST-as-GET $account.url

POST-as-GET $account.url
sign nonce invalid
error == badNonce

POST-as-GET $account.url
sign nonce missing
error == badNonce

POST-as-GET $account.url
sign header nonce "not-base64url!"
error == badNonce

POST-as-GET $account.url
sign header nonce "AAAA"
error == badNonce

POST-as-GET $account.url
sign header nonce 42
error == malformed

# A verified request spends its nonce even if its payload is rejected.
POST $account.url
payload {
error == malformed

POST-as-GET $account.url
sign nonce reuse
error == badNonce

POST-as-GET $account.url

# Nonce eviction is based on spend rate, not elapsed time.
sleep 1h

POST-as-GET $account.url

# Nonces are bound to the server, not the account: a nonce fetched by one
# client can be spent by another.
POST $dir.newAccount as account2
payload {"termsOfServiceAgreed": true}
$code == 201

POST-as-GET $account.url

# newNonce errors must not be cached, whether rejected by the handler or
# by the middleware before the handler runs.
POST $dir.newNonce
payload {}
error == malformed

POST $dir.newNonce
body not a JWS
error == malformed

POST-as-GET $dir.newNonce
sign nonce invalid
error == badNonce

# The nonce from the error response is usable here too.
POST-as-GET $dir.newNonce
